name: NTK — Near The Keyboard
note: build.mjs reads this file. Change a colour here, then run node build.mjs. High-key white, as in the reference scene: white blocks in 2:1 pixel isometric with very light cool-grey side faces (lit front, shaded right) and soft blurred shadows on a white floor with a faint grid. Black for small strong details, orange for a few accents. No outlines.

white.use: top faces of keys and small blocks

top.use: top faces of large blocks: the keyboard body, cards

lit.use: lit side faces (the front, lower left in isometric)

shade.use: shaded side faces (the right, lower right in isometric)

keyLit.use: lit side faces of keys (a touch deeper than large blocks, so the keys read)

grid.use: the faint square grid on the floor, 1 px lines

shadow.use: soft blurred shadows, at 8 to 18 % opacity

ink.use: the wordmark, text, legends, black details (18:1 on white)

slate.use: a dark block, if a scheme asks for one: top face

orange.use: accents: the Enter and Esc keys, the light, the main action, a verified stamp; icon backgrounds

grid.use: the faint grid on the floor

shadow.use: soft blurred shadows, at 40 to 60 % opacity

top.use: top faces of large blocks: the keyboard body, cards

lit.use: lit side faces of large blocks (lighter than the top)

shade.use: shaded side faces of large blocks

key.use: top faces of keys and small blocks

offWhite.use: the wordmark, text, legends (16:1 on space)

slate.use: a dark block, if a scheme asks for one: top face

keyboard.note: The Android keyboard theme (android/app/src/main/res/values{,-night}/colors-ntk.xml). Each key is a block: a top face, a lit face along its bottom and a shaded face along its right, cut at 45 degrees, and a soft blurred shadow, all inside the key; a press moves the top face down onto its side faces. Function keys a touch greyer. The Sign key is an orange block with a near-black legend (5.0:1 on orange).
